mission: A learned player must complete a fresh-start, model-directed Red run and the full local Red Pokedex before any ROM hack, then learn Crystal and continue the shared registered Pokedex through at least Emerald.

stages.title: Build the learning loop
stages.goal: Observe, act, verify, save and learn from actual outcomes.
stages.exit: Authenticated saved-state collection, retained-data fitting and a bounded post-fit continuation.
stages.scope: Teacher and deterministic mechanics support learning; they are not the final player.

stages.title: Make useful Red decisions
stages.goal: Remember failed searches and choose productive alternatives.
stages.exit: A history-aware learner chooses between useful executable goals, learns from the result and continues productively.
stages.scope: Search history must inform learned choices, not a scripted rule forcing another goal.

stages.title: Sustain model-directed play
stages.goal: Combine navigation, battles, captures, resources and recovery.
stages.exit: Repeated multi-goal progress across varied Red situations, with measured costs, interventions and recovery.
stages.scope: Replace brittle fixed routing with reusable skills; scale battle and navigation authority on evidence.

stages.title: Finish Red with the model
stages.goal: Choose progression from a fresh game through the Champion.
stages.exit: One authenticated fresh start-to-finish model-directed Red run with concurrent Champion and Hall-of-Fame evidence; no fixed walkthrough or checkpoint stitching.
stages.scope: Earlier checkpoint completion is supporting evidence, not this fresh-run gate.

stages.title: Complete the full Red Pokedex
stages.goal: Register every Red Pokedex entry in the same fresh-run save.
stages.exit: Full local Red registration in the authenticated model-directed run, with legitimate version, trade and event dependencies explicitly resolved before any ROM hack.
stages.scope: No reduced availability subset. Shared credit is not a local flag; no living-form quota.

stages.title: Adapt to an unfamiliar Red hack
stages.goal: Test changed encounters, rules or difficulty in a compatible hack.
stages.exit: Only after the full Red fresh-run/story/Pokedex gate: compare initial performance and adaptation with a learner lacking Red experience.
stages.scope: Blocked until complete Red. Compatibility and initial performance are separate tests.

stages.title: Transfer and learn Crystal
stages.goal: Reuse shared skills while learning new mechanics and progression.
stages.exit: Measured transfer and adaptation, then model-led story and new registrations against the shared ledger.
stages.scope: Add the title adapter, time-dependent encounters, breeding and new mechanics; not another fixed walkthrough.

stages.title: Accumulate a cross-game registered Dex
stages.goal: Continue the shared registered Pokedex through at least Emerald.
stages.exit: Per-title story completion and verified global species coverage with explicit version, trade, event and unsupported-mechanic gaps.
stages.scope: Learn new generation mechanics; retain truthful global, local and physical views.
